body.statement: When \(d=1\), \(D=[0,1]\), the sites are equally spaced, and the marginal ranges coincide, the leading covariance shape is \(H_N\to\begin{pmatrix}1&1&1\\1&2&2\\1&2&4\end{pmatrix}\) and \(q_N(p)\to(1,2^{2p-1},4^{2p-1})^{\mathsf T}\). Thus the proposed experiment reduces to the known Ornstein--Uhlenbeck nested-increment Gaussian limit, while the profile construction remains nonsingular at \(A=0\).
body.justification: This reduction is the required sanity check and fixes the covariance and mean normalizations in a fully tractable special case.
body.gap: Known two-scale cancellation assumes \(p\) known; the three-scale profiled reduction remains regular for \(\beta\) when \(p\) is unidentified.
body.consumer: It supplies a reproducible benchmark for implementations and for checking all constants in the general-design theorem.
